subject.title: fix: forward response-frame meta to clients

question: Should Gateway protocol v4 accept optional top-level `res.meta` on response frames after this branch is refreshed against current main?
rationale: This is the narrow code fix for the dropped metadata, but automation cannot decide the compatibility policy for adding a new top-level response-frame field that strict external validators may reject.

options.title: Accept additive `res.meta` after refresh
options.body: Resolve the current conflict, keep the optional field with Swift source compatibility, and land after focused gateway protocol checks pass.

options.title: Require a versioned or payload-level contract
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a different metadata contract if additive top-level response fields are not acceptable for v4 clients.

recommendation.title: Accept additive `res.meta` after refresh
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflict, keep the optional field with Swift source compatibility, and land after focused gateway protocol checks pass.
